title: 12 Best Ful Medames in Cairo
description: Discover the 12 best Ful Medames spots in Cairo for 2026. From legendary street stalls to modern cafes, find your perfect bowl of Egypt's beloved breakfast dish. Authentic flavors, local favorites & insider tips.

places.name: El Gahsh
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful medames bil zeit (with oil and a squeeze of lemon), served with fresh baladi bread and pickled vegetables.

places.name: Felfela
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful Felfela (their signature blend, often with butter and spices) or Ful Iskandarani (spicy, with peppers and tomatoes).

places.name: Gad
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with pastrami or a mix of ful and ta'ameya (falafel) in a sandwich for a hearty meal.

places.name: Zooba
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with butter & eggs, or the spicy ful with chili oil. Don't miss their fresh juices and ta'ameya (falafel).

places.name: El Tabei
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful Medames with tahini and a side of their perfectly cooked eggs. Ask for 'ful by the pottery' for a traditional serving.

places.name: Abou Rabea
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with linseed oil (zeit har) for a nutty flavor, or the spicy ful with green chili peppers.

places.name: Kazaz
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Ful Medames, perhaps with a side of Shakshuka (eggs cooked in tomato sauce) for a full breakfast spread.

places.name: Al-Ezaby
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with butter and a sprinkle of cumin, served piping hot with freshly baked bread.

places.name: Om Hassan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with green salad and ta'ameya for a classic, filling Egyptian breakfast combo.

places.name: Al-Sayeda Nafisa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with plain oil and a side of fresh onions for a truly authentic street food experience.

places.name: Abou Hassan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful with butter, or the refreshing Ful with yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil, if available.

places.name: El-Zahra
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ful Medames with tahini and a side of their fresh bread, or a hearty ful and eggs plate.
